policy: Read-only complete global and local program accounting in twelve previously independent-exact whole files on two identical pinned photos. Parser differs only by exports/import paths. Header bits include tree/entropy/transform/weighted/header fields; after-header bits include residuals, final states, prefix-plane data and padding. All section bits reconcile exactly. Shared nodes are counted once, not repeated per group. Structural or payload differences do not assign causal savings to one feature. No production, speed or parity claim.
